summary.verdict: RESISTANCE-ROBUSTNESS DIMENSION (metabolic bypass, zero-data from iML1515): of 270 essential metabolic functions, 205 are MONOTHERAPY-ROBUST (a single essential gene) and 46 are COMBINATION-REQUIRED (isozyme-buffered -> a single drug is bypassed; must hit the synthetic-lethal set — verified jointly lethal in 11/15 sampled sets by double-gene-deletion). For our picks: of 9 nominated broad-spectrum targets mapped, 8/9 (0.889) are individually essential = BYPASS-ROBUST (single-gene KO lethal => no metabolic reroute); the one exception is menC (non-essential aerobically) — the SAME target PREDVAL independently flagged as weak (1/3 experimentally essential), an internal-consistency check. So INTERCEPTA's shortlist is overwhelmingly resistance-robust to metabolic bypass, and the buffered essential functions are flagged as combination-required (synthetic-lethal) targets. **HONEST BOUNDS (falsify-first): (1) bypass-robustness PARTLY FOLLOWS from the chokepoint filter we already applied (a chokepoint has no alternative route by construction) — so this QUANTIFIES/CONFIRMS the picks on a resistance axis rather than independently discovering it; the genuinely new outputs are the menC exception and the 46 combination-required sets. (2) Models METABOLIC BYPASS only — NOT the main clinical routes (target-site mutation, efflux, drug modification). (3) iML1515/E. coli, glucose-minimal (essentiality is medium-dependent); combination-required sets are FBA predictions (11/15 verified => imperfect). Hypotheses, not validated; not wet-lab.**
